title: About
text: I am a postdoctoral fellow at the Centre for Child and Family Science. I mainly work on writing academic papers and reports based on the C-for-Chinese@JC Project, as well as other research projects related to the health and well-being of kindergarten-aged children. Meanwhile, I assist with coordinating survey data collection for a project on voluntary childlessness, in which over 1,000 women living in Hong Kong participated, and contributes to reporting based on these data.
